observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with a polished wood floor and ornate red/grey temple-style backdrop with steps
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer performs in center stage and moves forward from backdrop doors
observation.posture: torso upright with broad shoulders, knees bent low in deep stances, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: quick stepping patterns coordinated with percussion hits, lifting knees high and tapping feet, quick directional turns
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held wide with elbows raised, expressive hands with fingers splayed and fluttering gestures
observation.hips_and_torso: torso and shoulders shift and bounce with rhythms, strong facial expressions with wide eyes
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low squatting levels, quick spins and turns on the spot
observation.costume_and_props: elaborate traditional Balinese gold crown/headpiece, red and gold patterned tunic/collar with fringe, white sash, white undergarments, and leggings

signature_moments.what: dancer performs rapid foot-tapping and knee-lifts while holding arms wide with fluttering fingers
